title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: integermulti
text:
integer multi-commodity flow
integer multi-commodity flow
(definition)
Definition:
A
multi-commodity flow
in which the flow of each commodity through each
edge
must take an integer value. The term is also used to capture the multi-commodity flow problem in which each demand is routed along a single path.
Note:
From Algorithms and Theory of Computation Handbook, page 7-21, Copyright © 1999 by CRC Press LLC. Appearing in the Dictionary of Computer Science, Engineering and Technology, Copyright © 2000 CRC Press LLC.
